# Bazel targets that Bazel may skip as incompatible (--skip_incompatible_explicit_targets) without failing coverage.
# Format: GROUP<space>REGEX. GROUP is the shard group (linux, aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-apple-darwin,
# x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc); REGEX must match the whole label. Blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored.

# Upstream's Windows cross-compilation test variants are incompatible with Linux and macOS hosts.
linux .*-windows-cross
aarch64-apple-darwin .*-windows-cross
x86_64-apple-darwin .*-windows-cross
# The Windows sandbox crates' unit-test binaries only build for Windows.
linux //codex-rs/windows-sandbox(-rs|-service):.*-bin-unit-tests
aarch64-apple-darwin //codex-rs/windows-sandbox(-rs|-service):.*-bin-unit-tests
x86_64-apple-darwin //codex-rs/windows-sandbox(-rs|-service):.*-bin-unit-tests


# On Windows, Bazel skips upstream's Linux-hosted variants: Windows cross-compiled and Wine-executed tests, the Wine
# test support, and the package, remote-environment and release-compatibility tests. Linux shards run all of them.
x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm .*-(windows-cross|wine-exec-test)
x86_64-pc-windows-msvc .*-(windows-cross|wine-exec-test)
x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm //bazel/rules/testing/wine:wine-test-support-unit-tests|//codex-rs/cli:cli-app_server_daemon_package-test|//codex-rs/core/tests/remote_env_windows:smoke-test|//codex-rs/exec-server:exec-server-(current-version|historical-release|stable-release)-test
x86_64-pc-windows-msvc //bazel/rules/testing/wine:wine-test-support-unit-tests|//codex-rs/cli:cli-app_server_daemon_package-test|//codex-rs/core/tests/remote_env_windows:smoke-test|//codex-rs/exec-server:exec-server-(current-version|historical-release|stable-release)-test
